guide: GPUI Kit Design Guides @ 944803984cf0 (design review, accessibility, interaction states, data-heavy, interface language)
method: Real retained data on the live origin (sources kiln/Git, lattice/Jujutsu, native-ci/Git, redox/Pijul), candidate assets substituted by GET interception (web.html, web.js, web.css, ui.js, icons.js, project.*, source.js, source.css, work*, code-review*). Read-only: no non-GET request. Metrics per page: page errors, document horizontal overflow (px) and, at <=480px, interactive elements under 44px.
recorded_deviations: Navigation stays links: view tabs, breadcrumb, tree entries, history rows, newer/older, Use head and View file are <a href> with in-page plain-click navigation, so new tabs and browser history keep working.
Gutter line numbers are links for pointer use but leave the tab order (tabindex -1); Go to line is the keyboard path, so a 5,000-line file is not 5,000 tab stops.
On touch layouts (<=60rem) gutter numbers are not links (a tap on the number still selects); every other control keeps a 44px target.
interactions: Filter typing narrows at once, commits sq to the URL after 350 ms and keeps focus and caret in the filter (21 of 43 entries for 'rs').
Keyboard: Tab reaches tree entries; Enter opens the file and focus returns to the same entry after re-render.

Gutter click selects line 5, Shift-click extends to 5-9 without scrolling; Go to line '20-12' selects 12-20 and scrolls it into view; '99999' is refused with 'This file has 368 lines; nothing was selected.'
Reload/back restores sline exactly; sline=780-770 highlights 770-780 and the URL is not rewritten.
sline outside the file, garbage sline, sline without a file and sline on a binary file are each reported; nothing is highlighted.
Unknown source, missing file, invalid revision and a Pijul revision are reported explicitly; nothing is substituted.
History: More revisions appends 30 to 60 and keeps focus on More; a commit title opens its Changes; Older steps to the parent.
Changes: changed-files list jumps to the file section without changing the URL; binary files say 'no text diff'; truncation is stated at the top and on the last file.
Copy path reports 'Path copied.'; Wrap lines toggles aria-pressed and the wrapped layout.
